overview.headlineHtml: A boutique address on the Golden Mile
copy: Golden Mile Duplex Residences is an exclusive collection of just 8 residences, each furnished by a world-renowned luxury design house, on Marbella's most prestigious stretch of coastline.

The collection features four garden-level duplexes, each with 4 bedrooms, a private garden, a private pool, and dedicated spa and gym areas, alongside four skyline duplex penthouses with 3 bedrooms, open-concept living areas and panoramic sea views.
metrics: Private gardens, pools or rooftop terraces

constructionTimeline.copy: Reservation is followed by a private purchase contract and a balance on completion, both plus VAT, with pre-completion payments bank-guaranteed. Nueva Living confirms the construction schedule and delivery date before any reservation.
constructionTimeline.paymentTermsNote: Payment schedule as set out in the developer's current price list. The purchase price includes 2 parking spaces and a storage room. Buyers are also required to purchase a furnishing package from the development's luxury design partner, valued at €500,000 + VAT and offered at €300,000 + VAT -- Nueva Living confirms this and all other terms with you directly before any reservation.

why.copy: Golden Mile Duplex Residences suits buyers seeking a rare, ultra-boutique address on Marbella's most prestigious stretch of coastline, with a design pedigree few developments can match.
points: Buyers who want an ultra-exclusive, design-led home on the Golden Mile, in a collection of just 8 residences rather than a large development.
Every residence is furnished by a world-renowned luxury design house, with private gardens, pools and dedicated spa and gym areas on the garden duplexes.
Steps from Puente Romano Beach Resort and the Marbella Club Hotel, 5 minutes from Puerto Banús and 40 minutes from Málaga Airport.
Only 2 of the 8 residences remain; Nueva Living reconfirms live pricing and terms before any viewing.

copy: Each residence is conceived as a standalone masterpiece rather than a repeated unit, with curved architectural lines, full-height glazing and landscaped terraces that blur the line between indoor and outdoor living.

Interiors are furnished throughout by one of the world's most prestigious luxury design houses, a collaboration that extends from the furniture to the finishes, making each home a fully realised, turnkey work of design.
highlights: Private garden and pool on each garden-level duplex, with a dedicated spa and gym area.
Panoramic sea views and open-concept living on the skyline duplex penthouses.
A single, curated furniture and interior design package throughout every residence.

residences.copy: The collection spans two residence types: four-bedroom garden-level duplexes with private gardens and pools, and three-bedroom skyline duplex penthouses with panoramic sea views.

lifestyle.copy: Golden Mile Duplex Residences sits steps from Marbella's most legendary hospitality addresses, with the beach, fine dining and private members' clubs all within walking distance.
panels: Just steps from Puente Romano Beach Resort and the Marbella Club Hotel, surrounded by lush gardens and sea breezes.
Residents are invited to join the Owners' Club at the neighbouring five-star resort, with private lounges, concierge service and access to beach clubs, pools, padel, tennis and spa facilities.
5 minutes from Puerto Banús and 40 minutes from Málaga Airport, with over 150 direct international flight connections.
